test_title: PYST 28: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 4 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate idiom from the following options that can substitute the underlined part of the given sentence.**

The company considers this project as a prestigious one. So, it is ready to __allow more money to be spent.__
solution:
The correct answer is '**Loosen the purse strings**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate **idiom** that can substitute the **underlined part** of the given sentence is "**Loosen the purse strings**" which means **to spend more money than usual or to spend more money than one intends to**.
 
• So, the correct option is "**Loosen the purse strings**".

Thus, ***option 2*** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

__
 
• Loosen the purse strings : {सामान्य से अधिक पैसा खर्च करना या एक से अधिक पैसा खर्च करना}

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Hit the roof- suddenly become very angry.

 
 
• E.g.- Dad will hit the roof when he finds out I dented the car.
 
 
 
• Grease someone’s palm- Give someone money in exchange for a favor; also, bribe someone
 
 
• E.g.- If you want you luggage to make the plane, be sure to grease the porter's palm
 
 
 
• Lend someone a hand- to provide help
 
 
• E.g.- I'll be happy to lend a hand.
